actions.description:
Trigger The gang leader rolls a critical hit against a creature

Effect All allies that can see the gang leader gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls until the start of the gang leader's next turn.

Effect: Brutal Rally
actions.name: Brutal Rally
actions.trigger: The gang leader rolls a critical hit against a creature

actions.description:
Trigger The gang leader is targeted with an attack by an attacker they can see

Effect The gang leader gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
actions.name: Nimble Dodge
actions.trigger: The gang leader is targeted with an attack by an attacker they can see

actions.description: The gang leader Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.
actions.name: Quick Draw

actions.description: The gang leader isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 7th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.
actions.name: Deny Advantage

actions.description: When the gang leader rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.
actions.name: Evasive Reflexes

actions.description: Any enemy is Off-Guard against the gang leader's melee attacks due to flanking as long as the enemy is within melee reach of both the gang leader and one of the gang leader's allies.
actions.name: Gang Up

actions.description: The gang leader deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
actions.name: Sneak Attack

actions.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted are Off-Guard to the gang leader.
actions.name: Surprise Attacker

name: Gang Leader
publicNotes:
Gang leaders direct cutthroats, killers, thieves, and toughs. The gang leader often appears alongside a bandit gang or other criminals.

Villains pursue selfish and cruel goals, trampling over anyone in their way.
